top_findings.title: Not an MCP server — no MCP protocol, SDK, transport, or tool registration
top_findings.evidence: grep for mcp|jsonrpc|stdio|AddTool|RegisterTool across *.go returns nothing; go.mod has zero deps; server/server.go:653 Run() only prints a banner and runs one hardcoded query s.Query("Who won the 2019 Brasileirao?") (server.go:658). No tool definitions, no JSON-RPC/stdio loop.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an MCP server SDK, register the query functions as MCP tools, serve over stdio/JSON-RPC.

top_findings.title: Match-by-team lookup returns empty for all real data (case-mismatch bug)
top_findings.evidence: query/match_query.go:319 normalizeTeamName lowercases the query team; loader/loader.go:725 stores names case-preserved (no ToLower; empty-store alias lookup at loader.go:743). match_query.go:66/36 compare match.HomeTeam==team with ==, so "Palmeiras"=="palmeiras" is never true. Data present in data/kaggle/.
top_findings.suggestion: Normalize team-name case consistently between loader and query.

top_findings.title: Team W/L/D + goals stats always empty (same case-mismatch bug)
top_findings.evidence: query/match_query.go:154 GetTeamStats lowercases team (:155) then compares match.HomeTeam==team (:170-186); stored names are case-preserved so every TeamStats is all-zero.

top_findings.title: Head-to-head record always returns zeros (same case-mismatch bug)
top_findings.evidence: server/server.go:131 answerTeamMatchQuery -> query/match_query.go:212 GetHeadToHead -> FindMatchesByTeams (:218) lowercases queried teams and fails to match case-preserved stored names -> h2h has 0 matches.
